source.compiler: The game's own team files: the six national team files (TEAM.080 to 085) and the seven league files (TEAM.008 England, 013 France, 014 Germany, 020 Italy, 025 Holland, 029 Portugal, 035 Spain), as the SWOS United community server keeps them for its tools (cern.swos.eu/data/amiga/v1.0), read by scripts/lib/swos-files.mjs
source.provenance: The original release, v1.0, whose READ.ME is Sensible Software's note of Christmas 1994 (kept beside the files in data-src). The v1.1 update of early 1995 has the same national teams and later club squads; the v0.9 pre-release has no Uruguay. Read the same way, SWOS 96/97's own files agree with the shipped 96/97 database for 1,441 of its 1,463 national players; the other 22 are that database's price step 0 stored as 25K, Maldini's and Shearer's step 49 stored as 15M, and namesakes. So steps are read as that database stores them: 0 as 1 (25K) and 49 as 48 (15M). Roberto Baggio's and Romário's step 49 is read as 48.
